neighbours.label: ' some' after 'with' ahead of a vague plural
fire: The room warms up with some candles.
She fixed the fence with some nails.
We cleaned the floor with some rags.
He decorated it with some ribbons.
They fed the calf with some scraps.
I filled the box with some papers.
You can patch it with some tape.
The cook finished it with some herbs.
quiet: The room warms up with two candles.
She fixed the fence with long nails.
We cleaned the floor with old rags.
He decorated it with red ribbons.
They fed the calf with fresh scraps.
I filled the box with loose papers.
You can patch it with thick tape.
The cook finished it with green herbs.
